Opportunity: StrataWave is a mid-enterprise customer building an ML-first support assistant to deflect tickets and surface top-K KB articles. They ingest multi-source docs (help center, transcripts, release notes) -> target index ~150M chunks initially, expected to grow to 800M+ over 18 months.

Customer quotes: "Need consistent top-5 quality for reranking — if top result is wrong we lose trust"; "Strict 95th-percentile SLO: <= 180ms for embed+retrieve+rerank for small chats".

Key asks: tight latency (p95 <= 180ms, typical p50 ~60-80ms), deterministic top-5 rerank quality (human eval on sample prompts), cost targets (target ~$0.02/query at 1k qps amortized), ability to host in VPC or air-gapped on-prem for regulated clients.

Security: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML + SCIM, KMS integration mandatory for Private, retention controls and per-customer data residency. Legal wants a data processing addendum; security team shared a 40-item questionnaire (drive link above).

POC scope agreed: 1) indexing pipeline demo (ingest + embedding + incremental updates) 2) performance run at 200 qps then scale to 1k qps 3) reranking A/B against current Elastic + BM25 baseline on labeled set (target: lift precision@5 by >=12%).

Comments: highly sensitive to cold-start — want warm cache behavior and prefix KV reuse; prefer quantized model variants for cost but need AVX/GPU check for fidelity. Customer experimenting with sparse + dense retrieval combo.

Sales/AE notes: buyer committee includes Head of Support (primary champion), VP Eng (infra sign-off), Security director (audit lead). Budget conversation underway — procurement needs ARR band and MSA review.
